Three.js 0.186.1, MIT license (see LICENSE).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.1.tgz

The two browser modules from package/build are minified with esbuild 0.25.12,
using --minify --format=esm --legal-comments=inline. They are self-hosted so the
decorative wheel requires no external service. wheel-scene.js creates the model
procedurally; no third-party model or texture files are used.
